decisions.decision:
T-251 is done, so build on current main, not tantra-walkthroughs. Before editing, re-locate the AUDIT.md lines, because the line numbers predate e4bd0b8.
(1) N035: in workshop-cards.ts d2-close, when pay_checkout is 'After a call, by invoice', hide the checkout option and its fields and show one line saying no checkout is created.
(2) N037: add a 'Swap to your live key' step on the Dodo and Stripe connect cards, and a Day 3 card naming the exact field ('Replace the key').
(3) X071: add a jobs.ts poller that checks Dodo verification/live-mode status with the stored key. If the API exposes no status, use a daily check that surfaces the swap card. Prove it against the simulator, never a live account.
(4) X072: deploy-funnel generates privacy and terms pages from the attendee's business name and contact, hosts them on the funnel worker, and prefills pg_privacy_url.
Add probes, merge to main, deploy the centre, and mark X071, X072, N035 and N037 fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit.
decisions.why: T-251 is marked done, which unblocks the merge order. Every step is a code change on our own systems (orchestrator-autonomy). Dodo default and Stripe option come from owner-decisions-2026-10-06. Write paths use the simulator (vendor-accounts-no-change-rule).
